decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a multi-model naval lighting line for specialist robust environments, a core competence with long qualification cycles, so the sunk engineering cost and the long sales horizon favor persistence.
A spring-balanced desk lamp line with its own page shows visible commitment and fits the ergonomic workplace positioning, so modest early results can be attributed to market ramp-up.
A newly arrived second-generation general interior luminaire with its own page is a visible successor product in the core business, and dropping it so soon would expose the investment as a mistake.
The firm presented this microprismatic pendant luminaire as a flagship of its direction, so public commitment and centrality to its strategy make withdrawal very unlikely.

The marine HMI searchlight line is only mentioned on the website and relies on older HMI technology that is at odds with the firm's LED direction, which raises the risk somewhat, but marine customers' long product life cycles still favor keeping it.
This multi-model marine searchlight line serves established specialist marine customers with little public exposure, but the investment already made and the long project cycles support continuing it.
